div.div: Reading path ① Video arrives over LVDS, MIPI DSI or parallel RGB. ② The line buffer feeds the pixel pipeline, 24 bits per pixel. ③ Dithered pixels drive the column DACs. ④ High-voltage amplifiers drive the 3,840 column outputs. ⑤ The timing controller scans the rows through the gate driver. · dashed boxes are off-chip · pre-silicon architecture; values are design targets
